# reading of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:readingOf`](gmeow-readingOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/readingOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The inscription that a reading observes. Functional per relator: one source inscription per [`InscriptionReading`](../classes/gmeow-InscriptionReading.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InscriptionReading`](../classes/gmeow-InscriptionReading.md) -> [`gmeow:Inscription`](../classes/gmeow-Inscription.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:readingOf`](gmeow-readingOf.md) from [`gmeow:InscriptionReading`](../classes/gmeow-InscriptionReading.md) to [`gmeow:Inscription`](../classes/gmeow-Inscription.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    gmeow:vantage           ex:smith ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodExpertJudgement .

ex:readingJones a gmeow:InscriptionReading ;
    gmeow:readingOf         ex:inscription ;
    gmeow:readingResult     ex:transcriptJones ;
    gmeow:vantage           ex:jones ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodExpertJudgement .
